title: 〜一方だ / 〜いっぽうだ
meaning: keeps on …ing / continues only to… (one-directional change)
simpleExplanation: 〜一方だ says a change goes in one direction only and does not stop: 物価は上がる一方だ "prices just keep rising". It attaches to verbs of change (増える, 減る, 上がる, 悪くなる). The tone is often worried, but unlike 〜ばかりだ it can also describe a neutral or positive trend.
whenUsed: News, essays, business reports and everyday complaints about trends: 仕事が増える一方だ. Do not confuse it with 〜一方(で) "on the other hand", which links two clauses.
formation: Verb (dictionary form, change verb) + 一方だ / 一方です

examples.reading: ぶっかはあがるいっぽうだ。
examples.note: Prices keep going up; no sign of stopping.

examples.ja: 父の病気は悪くなる一方だった。
examples.reading: ちちのびょうきはわるくなるいっぽうだった。
examples.en: My father's illness just kept getting worse.

examples.ja: 仕事が増える一方で、休む暇がない。
examples.reading: しごとがふえるいっぽうで、やすむひまがない。
examples.en: Work keeps increasing and I have no time to rest.
examples.note: 一方で connective: the trend plus its consequence.

examples.ja: この会社の業績は、ここ数年伸びる一方だ。
examples.reading: このかいしゃのぎょうせきは、ここすうねんのびるいっぽうだ。
examples.en: This company's results have done nothing but grow these past few years.
examples.note: A positive trend: possible with 一方だ but not with ばかりだ.

examples.ja: スマートフォンの利用時間は長くなる一方です。
examples.reading: スマートフォンのりようじかんはながくなるいっぽうです。
examples.en: Time spent on smartphones just keeps getting longer.

similarGrammar.difference: Same structure but only for things getting worse.
'On the other hand' — links two contrasting clauses. Different meaning, same kanji.
Show direction in time but not the 'never stops' emphasis.

commonMistakes.wrong: 物価は上がった一方だ。
commonMistakes.why: 一方だ takes the dictionary form; the past goes on だ (一方だった).

commonMistakes.right: 彼は勉強ばかりしている。
commonMistakes.why: 一方だ needs a verb of change (increase, decrease, worsen). 勉強する is an action, not a change.

commonMistakes.right: 都会は便利になる一方だ。
commonMistakes.why: An adjective must be turned into a change with なる before 一方だ.

usageNotes: Frequent partners: 増える, 減る, 上がる, 下がる, 悪くなる, 高くなる, ひどくなる.
Sentence-initial 一方、 and clause-linking 一方で are the contrast meaning; sentence-final 一方だ is the trend meaning.
jlptTips: If the blank ends the sentence and the verb is about change, 一方だ is likely; if a second clause follows with a different subject, it is 一方で.
If the trend is positive (伸びる, よくなる), only 一方だ works, not ばかりだ.
Check the verb form: dictionary form only.
